definitions.full: H3625. Kelach II. [ כֶּ֫לַח ], כָּ֑לַח proper name, of a location city in Assyria Gen 10:11-12 , +? kal—u, Schr COT on the passage Dl Par 261 , modern Nimrûd , at northeast angle of Upper Zab and Tigris (see Billerbeck u. Jeremias BAS iii. 1895, 130 ff. )
